Her professional reputation has been ruined and she has no chance of getting into another big four company, and even smaller firms in her field (accounting) won't touch her. Kirsty was and is devastated and hasn't been doing much except crying in her room and going out clubbing with her friends. She has been like this for three months. and is starting to run low on money. Given that she has no chance of getting back into her career, I've been encouraging her to try to find some entry level work like retail/shop work or something like that. She had even been promoted to assistant manager not long before being sacked. Sarah had a go at me, saying that it wasn't fair for me to ''threaten'' her into getting a job that isn't good enough for her even though we don't need her rent money. I think I did the right thing. Happy to be a shoulder to cry on about the loss of her career, but not willing to let her spend the rest of her life living of us.
